routineId.description: The routine whose pre-check to run; never with preCheck and workspace.

preCheck.description: A pre-check not yet saved, with the workspace it runs in.

path.description: A script's path relative to the environment's scripts directory; it must stay inside that directory once links are followed, which the environment checks at each firing.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long the script may run before its process tree is killed, 1 to 600 seconds; 60 when absent.

oneOf.description: A script in the environment's scripts directory, run with no arguments; its standard output is the pre-check's output.

url.description: The URL fetched with a GET; its body is the pre-check's output.

oneOf.description: A URL fetched with a GET, up to five redirects; a status other than 2xx is a failure.

workspace.description: The workspace of the routine the pre-check is for, always with preCheck: a script runs in its directory, and a URL pre-check does not use it.

path.description: The directory on the environment's machine: an absolute path, or one starting ~ for the environment's home.

oneOf.description: A directory the environment has: recorded at its absolute path, ~ expanded to the environment's home, . and .. resolved as written and symlinks kept; refused workspace_unusable, with its problem, when the environment cannot use it.

repository.description: Any path inside the repository; the worktree is made from its main checkout.

branch.description: An existing local branch to check out in the worktree.

name.description: The new branch's name; agent-harness/ and the session id's first eight characters when absent.

base.description: The ref the branch starts from, any ref; the main checkout's HEAD when absent.

newBranch.description: A branch the worktree is made on, made with it.

oneOf.description: A worktree the environment makes from a repository it has: from its main checkout (or bare repository), under the environment's worktrees root, locked for the session, with the ignored files the checkout's .worktreeinclude names copied in; on an existing branch, or on a new one (the new branch with its presets when neither is named), nothing fetched. Refused with the reason git's answer gives: not_a_repository, git_unavailable, no_commits, git_filters_refused, branch_exists, branch_not_found, branch_checked_out or git_failed.
A scratch directory of the session's own.

repositoryIdentity.description: The repository identity the workspace resolved to when the routine was saved, which a move re-resolves it by; null outside a repository, for scratch, or before the environment has resolved it.
